queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'VSCodium' AND publisher = 'VSCodium';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'VSCodium' AND publisher = 'VSCodium' AND version_compare(version, '1.143.17232') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'vscodium.exe');
